jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales
jobs.program: NSW Summer Clerkship Recruitment Program 2027 (clerkships commencing late 2027)
jobs.notes: Scheme-wide dates for all signatory NSW firms: applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027, with offers from 9:00am 8 September 2027 and acceptances by 1:00pm 9 September 2027; the close date is listed as either Sunday 4 July or Sunday 11 July 2027 (11:59pm AEST) depending on the individual firm, so no single close date can be confirmed — eligibility is generally penultimate-year law students.

Firm's own early careers page confirms a future window aligned to the Law Society of NSW scheme — applications open 9:00am AEST 9 June 2027 and close 11:59pm AEST 11 July 2027, interviews from early August 2027 and offers from 8 September 2027.

The firm's seasonal clerkships page states applications are currently closed and will open in June for the 2027/28 program, but gives no exact 2027 open or close dates (per-office dates vary and follow each state Law Society/Law Institute scheme), so both fields are left null rather than guessed.
